title: Data and code for: DArT-based characterisation of genetic diversity in genotypes of Cucumis metuliferus collected from SACU
description: Raw DArT-seq SNP report and sample metadata for 120 Cucumis metuliferus (African horned cucumber) genotypes collected across the Southern African Customs Union (Botswana, Eswatini, Namibia and South Africa), together with a single R script (analysis.R, dartRverse) that reproduces every result and figure of Koopa et al. (2026), PLOS ONE: SNP filtering, diversity indices, PCA and its robustness to MAF filtering, genomic relationship matrix, dendrogram, fastSTRUCTURE population structure (K = 1 to 10, ten replicates), AMOVA, and the selection and validation of a 35-genotype core subset.
